Pick one to load into this browser. It runs on your own GPU; nothing is sent anywhere. The download happens once and is cached by the browser.

Qwen2.5 1.5B is the one that follows the course (routing, tool calls, citations). The smaller ones only prove the plumbing: they load fast, but their answers are poor. Needs about 2 GB of free disk and a GPU with enough memory.
